description: Representative Gregory Meeks (D) NY provides insights on the current state of the cryptocurrency market and discusses the concerns raised by other Democratic lawmakers in regards to crypto regulation. Meeks speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

description: Democrat Representative from Pennsylvania Brendan Boyle questioned why ICE is treated differently than other law enforcement officers when it comes to showing their faces to the public and said that the public is made 'less safe' by ICE's conduct in Minneapolis. Boyle said he is skeptical that the White House can reach a deal on ICE reform before DHS funding runs out again and is concerned the government will face a long-term partial shutdown. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: ICE Should Operate Under 'Normal Rules' of Law Enforcement, Says Brendan Boyle

author: Elizabeth Rembert
description: Most of the buildings at the University of Massachusetts were constructed in the 1950s and the 1960s, and the signs of aging are clear, President Marty Meehan says. When it rains, roofs leak. And even during harsh New England winters, students crack windows open to air out stuffy dorm rooms.
title: Massachusetts Eyes Its Millionaire Tax for Public Campus Revamp

description: Representative Nicole Malliotakis, a New York Republican, said the administration recognizes that the aggressive tactics of immigration officers are unpopular, but the lack of cooperation from local Democratic officials makes the situation more dangerous. Malliotakis said that she would like to see the Trump administration focus on expediting work permits for migrants, a move that would signal compassion from the White House and help the economy. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Aggressive ICE Tactics Have 'Not Been Popular,' Says Malliotakis

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

On today's show, Donald Trump warns Iran to be “very worried” as US military forces amass in the region. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says nuclear talks with the US are scheduled for tomorrow morning in Muscat. 

European equity futures and Asian shares dropped as AI concerns sparked a trillion-dollar tech wipeout over two days. Qualcomm fell post market after its sales outlook missed. Alphabet dipped despite topping revenue projections, and Arm tumbled on phone jitters.
               
Today's guests: Volvo Cars CEO Håkan Samuelsson & Peel Hunt Chief Economist Kallum Pickering. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump: Iran Should be ‘Very Worried’ & Trillion-Dollar Tech Wipeout | Daybreak Europe 2/05/2026

Japan will vote this Sunday after PM Sanae Takaichi called for a snap election last month.
